# Completed maintainer-recorded BigQuery round; archived for investigation.
# KLL sketch wire-format specimens, NOT golden serialization expectations.
# Investigation and interpretation: docs/architecture.md, KLL sketch format investigation.
# Each result is one cell; hex avoids SDK BYTES conversion. Queries use no tables.
# KLL is non-deterministic: retain recorded bytes as immutable reader fixtures,
# never assert that INIT or MERGE_PARTIAL reproduces these bytes.
# All returned bytes, including compressed sketches, are needed for format analysis.

# Singleton integer encodings: sign, varint boundaries, and full INT64 range.
SELECT ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(x, TO_HEX(s) AS hex) ORDER BY x)
FROM (
  SELECT x, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x) AS s
  FROM UNNEST([CAST('-9223372036854775808' AS INT64), -129, -128, -1, 0, 1, 127, 128, 255, 256, 9223372036854775807]) AS x
  GROUP BY x
)
?> [{"v":{"f":[{"v":"-9223372036854775808"},{"v":"0871100120048a072c088a1710e8071a0a80808080808080808001220a808080808080808080012a0c120a80808080808080808001"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"-129"},{"v":"0871100120048a072c088a1710e8071a0afffeffffffffffffff01220afffeffffffffffffff012a0c120afffeffffffffffffff01"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"-128"},{"v":"0871100120048a072c088a1710e8071a0a80ffffffffffffffff01220a80ffffffffffffffff012a0c120a80ffffffffffffffff01"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"-1"},{"v":"0871100120048a072c088a1710e8071a0affffffffffffffffff01220affffffffffffffffff012a0c120affffffffffffffffff01"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"0"},{"v":"0871100120048a0711088a1710e8071a01002201002a03120100"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"1"},{"v":"0871100120048a0711088a1710e8071a01012201012a03120101"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"127"},{"v":"0871100120048a0711088a1710e8071a017f22017f2a0312017f"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"128"},{"v":"0871100120048a0714088a1710e8071a028001220280012a0412028001"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"255"},{"v":"0871100120048a0714088a1710e8071a02ff012202ff012a041202ff01"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"256"},{"v":"0871100120048a0714088a1710e8071a028002220280022a0412028002"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"9223372036854775807"},{"v":"0871100120048a0729088a1710e8071a09ffffffffffffffff7f2209ffffffffffffffff7f2a0b1209ffffffffffffffff7f"}]}}]

# Singleton doubles: IEEE754, signed zero, infinities and NaN.
# Group by labels, not FLOAT64 values, to keep both zero representations.
SELECT ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(label, TO_HEX(s) AS hex) ORDER BY label)
FROM (
  SELECT label, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_FLOAT64(x) AS s
  FROM UNNEST([
    STRUCT('negative_zero' AS label, CAST('-0.0' AS FLOAT64) AS x),
    ('positive_zero', CAST('0.0' AS FLOAT64)),
    ('one', CAST(1 AS FLOAT64)),
    ('negative_fraction', CAST(-1.5 AS FLOAT64)),
    ('positive_fraction', CAST(1.5 AS FLOAT64)),
    ('nan', CAST('NaN' AS FLOAT64)),
    ('negative_inf', CAST('-inf' AS FLOAT64)),
    ('positive_inf', CAST('inf' AS FLOAT64))
  ])
  GROUP BY label
)
?> [{"v":{"f":[{"v":"nan"},{"v":"08711001200a8a0726088a1710e8071a08000000000000f87f2208000000000000f87f2a0a0a08000000000000f87f"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"negative_fraction"},{"v":"08711001200a8a0726088a1710e8071a08000000000000f8bf2208000000000000f8bf2a0a0a08000000000000f8bf"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"negative_inf"},{"v":"08711001200a8a0726088a1710e8071a08000000000000f0ff2208000000000000f0ff2a0a0a08000000000000f0ff"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"negative_zero"},{"v":"08711001200a8a0726088a1710e8071a080000000000000000220800000000000000002a0a0a080000000000000000"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"one"},{"v":"08711001200a8a0726088a1710e8071a08000000000000f03f2208000000000000f03f2a0a0a08000000000000f03f"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"positive_fraction"},{"v":"08711001200a8a0726088a1710e8071a08000000000000f83f2208000000000000f83f2a0a0a08000000000000f83f"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"positive_inf"},{"v":"08711001200a8a0726088a1710e8071a08000000000000f07f2208000000000000f07f2a0a0a08000000000000f07f"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"positive_zero"},{"v":"08711001200a8a0726088a1710e8071a080000000000000000220800000000000000002a0a0a080000000000000000"}]}}]

# Precision header candidates; keep each precision a literal aggregate argument.
SELECT ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(p, TO_HEX(s) AS hex) ORDER BY p)
FROM (
  SELECT 1 AS p, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 1) AS s FROM UNNEST([42]) AS x
  UNION ALL SELECT 2, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 2) FROM UNNEST([42]) AS x
  UNION ALL SELECT 100, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 100) FROM UNNEST([42]) AS x
  UNION ALL SELECT 1000, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 1000) FROM UNNEST([42]) AS x
  UNION ALL SELECT 2000, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 2000) FROM UNNEST([42]) AS x
  UNION ALL SELECT 100000, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 100000) FROM UNNEST([42]) AS x
)
?> [{"v":{"f":[{"v":"1"},{"v":"0871100120048a070f080310011a012a22012a2a0312012a"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"2"},{"v":"0871100120048a070f080510021a012a22012a2a0312012a"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"100"},{"v":"0871100120048a071008980210641a012a22012a2a0312012a"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"1000"},{"v":"0871100120048a0711088a1710e8071a012a22012a2a0312012a"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"2000"},{"v":"0871100120048a071108f82e10d00f1a012a22012a2a0312012a"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"100000"},{"v":"0871100120048a071308ca921410a08d061a012a22012a2a0312012a"}]}}]

# Non-singleton, duplicate, unsorted and negative inputs; identify min/max and buffers.
SELECT ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(label, TO_HEX(s) AS hex) ORDER BY label)
FROM (
  SELECT label, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x) AS s
  FROM UNNEST([
    STRUCT('pair' AS label, [1, 2] AS xs),
    ('reverse_pair', [2, 1]),
    ('duplicates', [7, 7, 7, 7]),
    ('unsorted', [9, -3, 5, -1, 9]),
    ('wide', [CAST('-9223372036854775808' AS INT64), 0, 9223372036854775807])
  ]), UNNEST(xs) AS x
  GROUP BY label
)
?> [{"v":{"f":[{"v":"duplicates"},{"v":"0871100420048a0714088a1710e8071a01072201072a06120407000000"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"pair"},{"v":"0871100220048a0712088a1710e8071a01012201022a0412020101"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"reverse_pair"},{"v":"0871100220048a0712088a1710e8071a01012201022a0412020101"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"unsorted"},{"v":"0871100520048a0727088a1710e8071a0afdffffffffffffffff012201092a10120efdffffffffffffffff0102060400"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"wide"},{"v":"0871100320048a073e088a1710e8071a0a808080808080808080012209ffffffffffffffff7f2a1f121d8080808080808080800180808080808080808001ffffffffffffffff7f"}]}}]

SELECT TO_HEX(KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_FLOAT64(x))
FROM UNNEST(ARRAY<FLOAT64>[9.5, -3.25, 5.125, -1.0, 9.5]) AS x
?> "08711005200a8a0746088a1710e8071a080000000000000ac0220800000000000023402a2a0a280000000000000ac0000000000000f0bf000000000080144000000000000023400000000000002340"

# NULL-only versus empty aggregation: distinguish NULL from a serialized empty state.
SELECT TO_HEX(KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x)) FROM UNNEST(ARRAY<INT64>[]) AS x
?> null

SELECT TO_HEX(KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x)) FROM UNNEST(ARRAY<INT64>[NULL, NULL]) AS x
?> null

SELECT TO_HEX(KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_FLOAT64(x)) FROM UNNEST(ARRAY<FLOAT64>[]) AS x
?> null

SELECT TO_HEX(KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_FLOAT64(x)) FROM UNNEST(ARRAY<FLOAT64>[NULL, NULL]) AS x
?> null

# Weight/count encodings without expanding billions of rows.
SELECT ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(w, TO_HEX(s) AS hex) ORDER BY w)
FROM (
  SELECT 1 AS w, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 1000, weight => 1) AS s FROM UNNEST([42]) AS x
  UNION ALL SELECT 2, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 1000, weight => 2) FROM UNNEST([42]) AS x
  UNION ALL SELECT 127, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 1000, weight => 127) FROM UNNEST([42]) AS x
  UNION ALL SELECT 128, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 1000, weight => 128) FROM UNNEST([42]) AS x
  UNION ALL SELECT 2147483647, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 1000, weight => 2147483647) FROM UNNEST([42]) AS x
)
?> [{"v":{"f":[{"v":"1"},{"v":"0871100120048a0711088a1710e8071a012a22012a2a0312012a"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"2"},{"v":"0871100220048a0715088a1710e8071a012a22012a2a0212002a0312012a"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"127"},{"v":"0871107f20048a072f088a1710e8071a012a22012a2a0312012a2a0312012a2a0312012a2a0312012a2a0312012a2a0312012a2a0312012a"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"128"},{"v":"087110800120048a072d088a1710e8071a012a22012a2a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312012a"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"2147483647"},{"v":""}]}}]

SELECT TO_HEX(KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_FLOAT64(x, 1000, weight => 2147483647))
FROM UNNEST(ARRAY<FLOAT64>[1.5]) AS x
?> ""

# Sample multiple sizes around possible compaction thresholds. No threshold is assumed.
# Grouping by n does not guarantee insertion order; do not infer buffer order from it.
SELECT ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(n, BYTE_LENGTH(s) AS size, TO_HEX(s) AS hex) ORDER BY n)
FROM (
  SELECT n, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 1) AS s
  FROM UNNEST([2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 1024]) AS n,
       UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, n)) AS x
  GROUP BY n
)
?> [{"v":{"f":[{"v":"2"},{"v":"25"},{"v":"0871100220048a0710080310011a01012201022a0412020101"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"4"},{"v":"38"},{"v":"0871100420048a071d080310011a01012201042a0212002a041202010232070a010410011801"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"8"},{"v":"42"},{"v":"0871100820048a0721080310011a01012201082a0212002a0212002a041202010432070a010710031802"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"16"},{"v":"45"},{"v":"0871101020048a0724080310011a01012201102a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010432070a011010071803"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"32"},{"v":"49"},{"v":"0871102020048a0728080310011a01012201202a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312010d32070a011c10091804"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"64"},{"v":"54"},{"v":"0871104020048a072d080310011a01012201402a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0412020c2632070a0140100b1805"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"128"},{"v":"59"},{"v":"087110800120048a0731080310011a0101220280012a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312013032070a017a102b1806"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"256"},{"v":"64"},{"v":"087110800220048a0736080310011a0101220280022a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0312015232080a02f90110651807"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"1024"},{"v":"75"},{"v":"087110800820048a0741080310011a0101220280082a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0612049502990532080a02f607101d1809"}]}}]

SELECT ARRAY_AGG(STRUCT(n, BYTE_LENGTH(s) AS size, TO_HEX(s) AS hex) ORDER BY n)
FROM (
  SELECT n, KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 1000) AS s
  FROM UNNEST([16, 64, 256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096, 16384]) AS n,
       UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, n)) AS x
  GROUP BY n
)
?> [{"v":{"f":[{"v":"16"},{"v":"41"},{"v":"0871101020048a0720088a1710e8071a01012201102a12121001010101010101010101010101010101"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"64"},{"v":"89"},{"v":"0871104020048a0750088a1710e8071a01012201402a42124001010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101010101"}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"256"},{"v":"286"},{"v":""}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"512"},{"v":"542"},{"v":""}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"1024"},{"v":"1054"},{"v":""}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"2048"},{"v":"2078"},{"v":""}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"4096"},{"v":"2656"},{"v":""}]}},{"v":{"f":[{"v":"16384"},{"v":"4963"},{"v":""}]}}]

FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(-2048, 2048)) AS x
?> "0871108120200a8a0769080310011a0800000000000070c0220800000000000070402a020a002a020a002a020a002a020a002a020a002a020a002a020a002a020a002a020a002a020a002a020a002a120a1000000000004867c00000000000f85240320f0a080000000000946b4010d606180b"

# Does one-input MERGE_PARTIAL preserve the encoding, or normalize it?
WITH source AS (
  SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x) AS s FROM UNNEST([9, -3, 5, -1, 9]) AS x
)
SELECT STRUCT(TO_HEX(s) AS original, TO_HEX((SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.MERGE_PARTIAL(s) FROM source)) AS merged)
FROM source
?> {"f":[{"v":"0871100520048a0727088a1710e8071a0afdffffffffffffffff012201092a10120efdffffffffffffffff0102060400"},{"v":"0871100520048a0727088a1710e8071a0afdffffffffffffffff012201092a10120efdffffffffffffffff0102060400"}]}

# Exact-state mixed-precision merge, and compacted-state mixed-precision merge.
SELECT TO_HEX(KLL_QUANTILES.MERGE_PARTIAL(s))
FROM (
  SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 1000) AS s FROM UNNEST([1, 2, 3]) AS x
  UNION ALL
  SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 2000) FROM UNNEST([4, 5, 6]) AS x
)
?> "0871100620048a0716088a1710e8071a01012201062a081206010101010101"

SELECT TO_HEX(KLL_QUANTILES.MERGE_PARTIAL(s))
FROM (
  SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 1) AS s FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 4096)) AS x
  UNION ALL
  SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x, 1000) FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(4097, 8192)) AS x
)
?> "087110804020048a074c080310011a0101220280402a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a0212002a041202b92732090a02ad1410830c180c"

SELECT TO_HEX(KLL_QUANTILES.MERGE_PARTIAL(s))
FROM (
  SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_FLOAT64(CAST(x AS FLOAT64) / 8, 1) AS s FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, 4096)) AS x
  UNION ALL
  SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_FLOAT64(CAST(x AS FLOAT64) / 8, 1000) FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(4097, 8192)) AS x
)
?> "0871108040200a8a076d080310011a08000000000000c03f220800000000000090402a020a002a020a002a020a002a020a002a020a002a020a002a020a002a020a002a020a002a020a002a020a002a020a002a120a100000000000f069400000000000e38d40320f0a080000000000927840108108180c"

# Decoder validation without guessing the as-yet unknown KLL protobuf fields.
SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_INT64(b'', 2)
?> error: Invalid input sketch bytes; error in KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_INT64 expression

SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_INT64(b'not a sketch', 2)
?> error: Invalid input sketch bytes; error in KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_INT64 expression

SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_INT64(SUBSTR(s, 1, BYTE_LENGTH(s) - 1), 2)
FROM (SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x) AS s FROM UNNEST([42]) AS x)
?> error: Invalid input sketch bytes; error in KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_INT64 expression

SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_INT64(CONCAT(s, b'\xff'), 2)
FROM (SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.INIT_INT64(x) AS s FROM UNNEST([42]) AS x)
?> error: Invalid input sketch bytes; error in KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_INT64 expression

# A valid HLL envelope must not be mistaken for KLL.
SELECT KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_INT64(s, 2)
FROM (SELECT HLL_COUNT.INIT(x) AS s FROM UNNEST([1, 2, 3]) AS x)
?> error: Invalid input sketch bytes; error in KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_INT64 expression
